g.text: Is the MetaQuotes Moving Average EA worth anything on EURUSD H1? Test 2020-2025,
then see if tuning MovingPeriod/MovingShift helps.
With default inputs the EA loses
Only 8 of 60 combinations make money and the best one (PF 1.15) is
in-sample. Next step: a walk-forward to check whether any of it survives
